hooks.text: 关键时刻可暂停时间，同时规划基地建造与军队移动，再恢复实时战局
hooks.excerpt: Don't let time be your enemy; make tactical decisions by pausing the game during critical moments. You can plan the building of your base, assign army movement, or use it to make yourself a hot drink: you deserve it.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 一边维持资源、人口温饱和防线，一边训练军队抵挡数千虫群撞墙
hooks.excerpt: Managing your settlement is crucial in Here Comes The Swarm . Gather enough resources for upgrades and expansion while keeping your population fed and happy . Make sure your defenses are ready when the swarm comes. Build the army you want, and train your units to ready them for the hive's strongest enemies . Strength comes in numbers for the swarm , and their onslaught will be unrelenting . Get ready to find thousands of fiends trying to breach your walls.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 选择不同神祇赐福，并用遭遇战获得的奥术精华解锁改变规则的节点来定制流派
hooks.excerpt: Choose between various deities and their divine powers to help you on your journey. Their blessings may very well be the difference between survival and defeat . Will you focus on attack, defense, or something completely different ? Find Arcane essences on your skirmishes to upgrade your Arcanum , unlocking new, powerful nodes that will change the game . Choose between these new boons to further tailor the game to your own preference.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
